content.title: THE SNACK DRAWER FIX FOR YOUR MOST ANNOYING EVERYDAY PROBLEMS
facts: **Follow along** – for more simple food fixes like this.
content.caption:
Fennel seeds are an old-school fix for bloating because they relax the smooth muscle lining your gut, which lets trapped gas move through instead of sitting there building pressure. Walnuts help with brain fog thanks to their omega-3 content, which supports blood flow to the brain and keeps communication between neurons running smoothly. And bananas work on muscle cramps because they're loaded with potassium, a mineral your muscles need to contract and relax properly — low levels are one of the most common hidden causes of that sudden charley horse. Everyone's body is different, so pay attention to what actually helps yours.

At @smarthealthfix we focus on four things: everyday nutrition, common health complaints, the organs that keep you running, and the small daily habits that quietly shape how you feel. Our mission is to help you build realistic, sustainable habits instead of chasing quick fixes that never stick.
